releaseNotes: Repo-root documentation regrouped by subject. CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and SECURITY.md move to .github/, where GitHub reads them from either location; ARCHITECTURE.md and VALIDATORS.md become docs/architecture.md and docs/validators.md. docs/ itself splits into method/ (the workflow-loop design and its dry run, 113KB of prose that was sitting at the same level as a one-page index) and prototypes/ (the three standalone HTML proofs and the fixtures they read). check:no-slop's repoDocs list moved with the files: it skips a path that does not exist, so relocating SECURITY.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md without touching the gate would have dropped both from the scan while CI stayed green.

playbook/process/ split into process/ and orchestration/. It held fifteen files, half again the next-largest lane, covering two different jobs: sequencing and proving a launch (phases, coverage, traceability, artifact contracts, change cascade, provider proof) versus driving the work (durable state, autonomy mode, subagents, dynamic workflows, CE routing). The second set moves to playbook/orchestration/ with its own README index. The three files sharing one identical trigger row — project-state, autonomy-modes, parallel-agent-orchestration — moved together and the new index says why they load together rather than leaving three duplicate rows to read as an accident.

The new SKILL.md lane row was paid for by compressing the row it split from, per the freeze-and-subtract rule: the entrypoint is 20,247 bytes against a 20,480 ceiling that did not move. check-workflow-adherence.ts built two of its paths from path.join segments rather than a literal, so a text-level rewrite missed them; both are updated here and the gate is what caught it.

business/ was examined for the same treatment and deliberately left alone. It is not a folder of skill files — roughly twenty gates run with --root business and read it as a business-repo root, so operations/agent-operations.json, design-system/tokens.css, state/business.json and secrets/SECRETS.md are the literal paths a launched repo carries at its own root, and PROJECT_STATE.yaml's evidence paths resolve against it. Regrouping business/ into docs/pages/app/data would redefine the directory layout of every business this skill launches, not tidy the skill. docs/architecture.md now records that constraint so the idea is not re-proposed as a cleanup.
